shortDescription: Manage group members on GitLab Server

options.name: access_level
options.description: The access level for the user. Required if O(state=present), user state is set to present. Mutually exclusive with O(gitlab_users_access).

options.name: api_job_token
options.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

options.name: api_oauth_token
options.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: api_token
options.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

options.name: gitlab_group
options.description: The C(full_path) of the GitLab group the member is added to/removed from. Setting this to C(name) or C(path) has been disallowed since community.general 6.0.0. Use C(full_path) instead.

options.name: gitlab_user
options.description: A username or a list of usernames to add to/remove from the GitLab group. Mutually exclusive with O(gitlab_users_access).

options.name: gitlab_users_access
options.description: Provide a list of user to access level mappings. Every dictionary in this list specifies a user (by username) and the access level the user should have. Mutually exclusive with O(gitlab_user) and O(access_level). Use together with O(purge_users) to remove all users not specified here from the group.

options.name: purge_users
options.description: Adds/remove users of the given access_level to match the given O(gitlab_user)/O(gitlab_users_access) list. If omitted do not purge orphaned members. Is only used when O(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the member in the group. On V(present), it adds a user to a GitLab group. On V(absent), it removes a user from a GitLab group.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint.
